task.title: Maintaining a Secure WiFi Network
task.shortdesc: Maintaining a secure personal wifi network through best practices regarding your wifi router, wifi password, and guest access.

context.note: It is important to maintain a secure wifi connection even outside of NC State's VPN and wifi network on campus. Personal wifi routers should follow these best practices to protect your personal devices from potential cybersecurity threats

step.cmd: Create a strong password for your wifi network that is sufficiently long and complex.
Turn off your wireless network when you will not be using it for an extended period.
Ensure that your guest-access profile on your wifi network is password protected.
Turn on automatic updates for your network devices’ firmware.

info.note: If automatic updates are not offered, periodically check for firmware updates on the network devices’ website(s) and manually download and install them.

step.cmd: Position the router away from windows and as far into the interior of your house as possible to limit the range of the wifi signal outside your home

info.note: If your router is compromised or if you cannot remember the password, you can restore it to the default factory settings by pressing the reset button usually located on the back of the router.
